:::{#def-riemann-sum}
#### Riemann sum

Let $f$ be a function on $[a, b]$,
let $\mathcal{P}$ be a partition $a = x_0 < x_1 < \cdots < x_n = b$ of $[a, b]$ (@def-partition),
and choose a **sample point** $x_i^*$ in each subinterval $[x_{i-1}, x_i]$.
The **Riemann sum** of $f$ for $\mathcal{P}$ and these sample points is

$$\sumin f(x_i^*)\,\change x_i,$$

where $\change x_i = x_i - x_{i-1}$.

[@larsonCalc11e, Section 4.3]

:::
